ai_summary: Bhansali Engineering Polymers Limited (BEPL) reported strong year-over-year revenue growth for Q2 and H1 FY2027 and declared a second interim dividend of Re.1 per share. However, its critical Rs. 200 crore ABS production capacity expansion faces a significant six-month delay, now projected for completion by March 2027 due to global geopolitical conflicts disrupting supply chains. This material delay is a key red flag, impacting future growth realization and necessitating operational realignment to minimize production loss.
